name: interactive-grid
title: Interactive Grid
description: Physics-based grid simulation that distorts an image in response to cursor movement. Each grid cell tracks mouse velocity and decays back to rest over time. Lit Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
React
Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-kit/interactive-grid-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-interactive-grid
  src="/path/to/image.jpg"
  grid={15}
  mouse-size={0.15}
  strength={0.35}
  relaxation={0.9}
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/interactive-grid-element.js"></script>

<motion-interactive-grid
  src="/path/to/image.jpg"
  grid="15"
  mouse-size="0.15"
  strength="0.35"
  relaxation="0.9"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: src
props.description: The image source URL to apply the distortion effect to.

props.name: grid
props.description: Grid resolution — number of cells per row/column. Higher values create finer distortion detail.

props.name: mouse-size
props.description: Radius of mouse influence as a fraction of the grid size (0–1).

props.name: strength
props.description: Strength of the distortion effect. Higher values produce more dramatic warping.

props.name: relaxation
props.description: How quickly cells return to rest after the cursor leaves (0–1). Values closer to 1 decay more slowly.
